title: Working Student Data & AI (m/f/d)
description: About BetterDoc We are BetterDoc, a digital health company with more than 200 employees in Cologne and Basel. We support patients with serious illnesses and complex diagnoses in finding the right specialists for their health concerns. To do this, we bundle, structure and analyze quality-relevant data from the healthcare sector. Since 2012, we have supported more than 100,000 patients. We have been part of the Otto Group since 2022 and work closely with our sister company Medgate, one of Europe's leading telemedicine providers. You study medicine and are already exploring what AI can do? With us, you bring both together. You test prompts for real data requests, review AI outputs with your medical knowledge and help build small prototypes. And you see how they turn into products. Our team Medical Science is the medical core of BetterDoc. We turn medical knowledge into products: structured data, decision logic and, more and more, AI. Our physicians build prototypes themselves and take them live together with Product and Engineering. As a working student, you are part of this team. We are looking for a working student (m/f/d) to join us as soon as possible, based in Cologne or remote. Your mission Day-to-day work Maintain our medical database: Keep our medical database up to date through targeted research, structured data preparation and systematic validation. Analyses and reporting: Contribute to analyses of medical data for internal decisions. Improve processes: Help develop and automate the workflows and concepts around our database. AI and prototypes Develop prompts and prototypes: Write and test prompts and build small tools together with the team, for example with Claude, Python, SQL or Google Apps Script. Review AI outputs medically: Assess the results of our AI applications, help build test and reference datasets, and find errors before they reach patients. Structure medical knowledge: Turn medical information into structured data and classifications such as ICD, OPS and SNOMED CT. Work with the product team: Bring your medical perspective to the development of our internal systems with Product and Engineering, and see how a prototype becomes a product. Your profile You study medicine and are enrolled at a German university, ideally in the clinical phase. You have a soft spot for AI: You already use tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor, and maybe you have even built something of your own. Technical curiosity: First experience with SQL, Python or databases is a plus, not a requirement. You are confident with spreadsheets in Excel or Google Sheets. You work carefully, in a structured and precise way and keep track even of larger datasets. Fluent German and good English. You enjoy working in a team and also independently. What BetterDoc offers you AI tools and time to experiment – Work with modern AI tools such as Claude and Claude Code, with room to try out new ideas. Learn from physicians who build – Work closely with our Medical Science team and discover a career path beyond the clinic. Flexible alongside your studies – Your hours fit around semesters, exams and clinical electives. Remote work is possible. Make a real impact – Help patients find the right specialists more easily. A strong backing – Work for a successful digital health company, supported by Medgate and the Otto Group. Further benefits – Office in the heart of Cologne (dogs welcome), team events, modern hardware, subsidized Deutschland-Ticket, Urban Sports Club contribution, corporate benefits and a company pension plan (bAV) with a 30% employer contribution. For you and your family – Free access to BetterDoc and the Medgate video consultation service at any time. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
